summary.text: Lauren Cheape Matsumoto, a Republican, represents District 38 in the Hawaii House of Representatives and has been House Minority Leader since 2022, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, she attended Mililani High School and earned a BA in film production from the University of Hawai'i at Manoa and an MBA from Hawaii Pacific University in 2015.
The biography says she won the title of Miss Hawai'i 2011, began serving in the Hawaii House of Representatives in 2012, and was named a Toll Fellow of the Council of State Governments in 2015.
